blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — “I am confident that I did nothing wrong.” This was the statement of comedian Mr. JP Aguilera of Pencilbox Comedy, explaining his controversial playground post was only “part of dark humor” and “does not intend to sexualize” children.” Aguilera appeared before the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI)’s Violence Against Women and Their Children (VAWC) Division on Friday to comply with the subpoena issued to him following his post.
